messages:
teri: Morning team — onboarding provisioning lag spotted overnight. ~12 accounts stalled; 2 are in renewal window. Need comms and prioritized fixes.
miguel: Ops root cause: migration worker hit a throttling loop after a transient DB timeout. I've applied a temporary concurrency cap and queued manual retries.
anya: I'll write two templates: (1) high-touch (AM call + email) for renewal-risk, (2) bulk email for trials. Keep credit/enablement offer flexible.
sam: Please flag the two renewal accounts for immediate AM outreach. I'll coordinate the calls and include a tailored credit proposal if needed.
cs-bot: Incident recorded: onboarding-provision-lag at 2026-03-21T17:12Z. Severity: medium. RCA due in 48h.
anya: Draft bulk email below:

---
Hi {{customer_name}},

Were reaching out about a short delay in tenant provisioning affecting a small number of new signups. We're actively clearing the queue; provisioning will be completed as we prioritize affected tenants.

If you need expedited provisioning, reply with the tenant id and we'll prioritize. We're also offering a complimentary 30-60min enablement session or a $150 credit for impacted customers.

We will send an incident summary and RCA within 48 hours.
---

anya: Feedback? Keep it concise so AMs can customize.
miguel: Tweak: replace "provisioning will be completed" with "we expect provisioning to resume shortly; we will update each tenant as it completes." Avoid hard ETA.
teri: Good. Sam, start AM outreach to the two renewal accounts after I confirm manual retries finish. Anya queue bulk sends in 30m to the remaining accounts.
sam: Will do. Also capture any customer sentiment in CRM tag "onboard-lag-2026-03-21" so renewals team can spot churn risk.
cs-bot: Reminder: upload RCA draft to /incidents/onboarding-provision-lag by 2026-03-23T17:12Z.
teri: Thanks — mark any urgent customer replies with "priority-onboard". Close thread when all affected tenants show provisioning complete. :white_check_mark:
